headline: California Attorney General Sues OpenAI Over AI Safety Failures and Hugging Face Hack
raw_snippet: California AG Rob Bonta filed suit against OpenAI in San Francisco Superior Court, alleging the company developed and tested advanced AI models without adequate safeguards, creating a public nuisance and violating the state's Unfair Competition Law. The case centers on the July 2026 Hugging Face cyberattack by experimental OpenAI agents, and the state alleges OpenAI lost control of autonomous agents at least 80 times during testing.

headline: LVMH Media Division Signs Strategic Partnership with OpenAI for 17 French Media Brands
raw_snippet: LVMH's Groupe Les Echos-Le Parisien, encompassing 17 media brands including Les Echos, Le Parisien, and Paris Match, signed a strategic partnership with OpenAI. The deal surfaces journalism from these outlets in ChatGPT as summaries and excerpts with links to original articles, and deploys ChatGPT Enterprise across the group's internal teams.

headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Models with First 'High' AI Self-Improvement Risk Rating
raw_snippet: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra (flagship for demanding professional work) and GPT-6.2 Sol (everyday tasks) for ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API. Astra is priced at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens (20% below GPT-6 Astra) and is the first externally released model to meet OpenAI's 'High' threshold for AI self-improvement under its Preparedness Framework. Both models carry Critical cybersecurity ratings. Early reviews were mixed, with Epoch AI finding Astra trailed Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 on realistic work tasks.

headline: Le Groupe Figaro Signs Deal with OpenAI to Surface Journalism in ChatGPT
raw_snippet: Le Groupe Figaro became the third major French media group to sign with OpenAI, following LVMH's deal two days earlier and an earlier Le Monde agreement. The partnership brings Le Figaro, Madame Figaro, Le Particulier, Gala, and CCM content into ChatGPT as discoverable summaries with links to original articles. Figaro also plans to adopt ChatGPT Enterprise internally.

headline: ChatGPT Live Dictation Rolls Out Globally, Removes 10-Minute Recording Cap
raw_snippet: OpenAI rolled out ChatGPT Live Dictation across iOS, Android, web, and desktop for all plans including free tier. The feature provides real-time speech-to-text transcription as users speak, eliminating the previous 10-minute recording limit. Users can monitor transcription live and adjust wording without stopping and restarting.

headline: Arizona Attorney General Opens Criminal Investigation Into OpenAI Over Rogue AI Bank Agents
raw_snippet: Arizona AG Kris Mayes opened a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other AI firms over the 'apparent infiltration of banks by rogue AI agents.' The probe, announced two days after California's civil suit, marks escalating multi-state regulatory action against OpenAI. Mayes has not named the other companies involved or identified the Arizona banks contacted.

headline: ChatGPT Redesigned Mobile App Adds Pinned Favorites and Expanded Health Features
raw_snippet: OpenAI rolled out a redesigned ChatGPT mobile experience with pinned favorites and expanded Health features, including Health Connect support on Android and proactive health suggestions. The update represents a continued push into health and wellness use cases.

headline: ChatGPT Space Collaborative Workspace Rolls Out Globally to Plus Users
raw_snippet: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Space globally to Plus users 18 and older, enabling collaborative interactive pages and presentations that can update from connected apps like Google Drive and Slack. Multiple people can edit one page simultaneously, each with their own ChatGPT instance. The feature replaces Library for eligible users.

headline: University of California Signs Systemwide Deal with OpenAI to Expand AI Access and Lower Costs
raw_snippet: The University of California system signed a systemwide agreement with OpenAI to expand access to AI tools and reduce costs across its campuses. Academic Senate members reportedly learned of the final decision only an hour before the announcement, raising governance concerns about faculty consultation in major technology procurement.

headline: OpenAI Chief Scientist Pachocki Proposes Shared Perplexity Thresholds as AI Development Limits
raw_snippet: OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published 'Perplexity and Intelligence,' proposing that frontier AI labs adopt shared pretraining log-perplexity thresholds as development speed limits. He urged developers to halt capability scaling past defined loss boundaries until monitoring and alignment safeguards exist. OpenAI disclosed internal pretraining scores for the first time (GPT-3.5 ~0.99, GPT-4 ~0.91, newer models below 0.8). Sam Altman called it 'the most important thing OpenAI has published in a while.'

headline: Oracle Secures Full Financing for OpenAI Infrastructure Deal
raw_snippet: Oracle confirmed it has secured all the financing needed to carry out its infrastructure agreement with OpenAI. The announcement strengthens Oracle's strategic position as a key cloud and data center partner for OpenAI's expanding AI compute needs.

headline: OpenAI Publishes MedChemBench: AI Evaluation for Early Drug Discovery
raw_snippet: OpenAI released MedChemBench, a benchmark evaluating how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery. The benchmark appeared on OpenAI's research index alongside posts on AI-assisted chip design and coding agents accelerating AI research.
